summary: Customer C11663 reported unauthorized activity on card C11663-K1, specifically disputing transaction 3660153. An investigation identified a burst of seven online product-C transactions between January 22 and January 31, 2017, totaling $8,551.47, with amounts escalating from $181.73 up to four consecutive $1,800.00 charges. This activity sharply deviates from the cardholder's baseline of predominantly in-person product-W purchases, during which the customer continued legitimate physical card use. Furthermore, 20 other cards across the issuer showed an identical online product-C burst signature during January 2017. The case is confirmed as card-not-present fraud, and card blocking and SAR filing actions have been executed.
open_question: While the unauthorized online burst clearly establishes card-not-present fraud, the exact point of compromise cannot be determined from the graph as no device metadata was recorded on the transactions.

waiting.why: R2: customer states they did not make the transaction; exposure $8,551.47
3a: the fraud connects to 20 other card(s), which is a connection to another customer's fraud
